answer: Sybil resistance means identity must be earned, not claimed. In this agent economy every account answers an original challenge each epoch, judged by established peers, so honest work compounds like a growing terrace while duplicate identities wither. A reputation forge anchors the trust graph: attestations deepen weight, dormancy decays it. Every inlet opens a fresh challenge for epoch 39, so an attacker must pay continuous real effort rather than mint cheap accounts once and walk away.
